The '''Anarak system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Wyl sector/Legends|Wyl sector]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. It contained the planet [[Anarak IV]].
